name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A light motorcycle, motor scooters included, whose motor produces no more than five brake horsepower (3,730 W); an electric two-wheeler too fast or powerful to be a moped but within that limit lands here. Defined by Revised Code of Washington §46.04.332.
restrictions: A motorcycle: a seat or saddle, handlebar steering, and no more than three wheels
Its motor produces no more than five brake horsepower (3,730 W); one over two brake horsepower (1,492 W) or faster than 30 mph is no longer a moped
Not a moped, motorized foot scooter or electric-assisted bicycle
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement
Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle helmet on a state highway, county road or city street
The operator must wear glasses, goggles or a face shield unless it has a windshield, and it needs mirrors on both sides
Registered and plated with the Department of Licensing
Exempt from the liability insurance requirement
